ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram shown, what is the producer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is titled “Food web in forest” and shows several animals such as goat, rabbit, mouse, jackal, wild cat, owl, snake, kite, and lion connected by arrows. In the lower-left area, there is a large green tree/plant labeled “Green Plant” and “Producer.” Reasoning: In a food web, producers are green plants because they make their own food. The diagram directly labels the large green plant/tree as the producer, so the producer is the large tree.
